name: Fall Love Story
source:
You are a normal student going to school with divorced parents. One day, there is a school play and the play is going to be Snow White. And the love story goes on as you meet three different girls, all of which have different characteristics, lifestyles, etc. 

[Edited from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=411&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
